01

The mobile hero paints inconsistently

The first-screen team image #image-695-968 is only 15 KB, but Google mobile LCP varied from 3.45 to 10.27 seconds, with a 2.09-second observed render delay in the repeat trace and the exact cause still unisolated.

  • Trace the hero’s paint around synchronous WhatConverts 141384.js, jQuery 3.7.1 and the Oxygen styles; do not blindly recompress the small image or add async to dependent scripts.
  • Retest repeatable mobile loads after dependency-safe changes, preserving call tracking and booking; the observed trace timings are not the separately simulated LCP total.
02

Two article links reach a missing page

The implant-lifespan and extraction-socket articles link to a singular “implant” URL that returns HTTP 404, while the plural “implants” article is live.

  • Change both “Dental Implants Pros And Cons” links directly to the verified plural URL shown below.
  • Add the proposed exact 301 from the singular URL to that article; do not redirect it to the homepage.

03

The category page has no normal layout

The Oral Health category returns ten full articles without a normal site header, page title, canonical or mobile viewport, leaving a raw document rather than a usable article archive.

  • Repair the category template with site navigation, one archive heading and linked excerpts instead of full article copies.
  • Choose whether it should be an indexable landing page or a noindex/follow browsing page; keep the underlying articles intact.
04

The business schema needs a small cleanup

The homepage Organization has a malformed X profile URL and no declared ID for the doctor’s organization reference, while the repeated Dentist rating count remains 644 versus GBP’s 754.

  • Correct Organization.sameAs to https://x.com/Starlite_Dental and declare the Organization ID used by Person.worksFor; preserve the correct Dentist name, pin, phone and hours.
  • If keeping the rating metadata, synchronize it with the visible verified source; keep these corrections in one schema task and do not remove the valid Dentist markup.
05

The assistance phone needs confirmation

The Accessibility Commitment page visibly lists (469) 589-5780, which differs from the practice number and is absent from the five verified tracking numbers, but its ownership and routing are unconfirmed.

  • Confirm who owns this assistance number and where it routes before treating it as wrong.
  • If it is unrelated or retired, replace it with the approved practice contact route; preserve the five confirmed tracking numbers.

Fix order

Start with the broken link and category template, then isolate mobile paint, clean the schema and confirm the assistance number alongside existing assigned work.

  • Website: exact link/redirect map, category layout, focused speed diagnostics and the single schema package.
  • SEO/owner: archive indexability and assistance-number confirmation; reuse existing homepage, service, metadata and internal-link tasks.

Read-only public crawl, Google lab tests, GSC/GA4 and exact GBP checks. Field CWV is unavailable; speed causality and assistance-number routing are not fully isolated. Completed award/measurement work, hidden legacy CTA, normal phone tracking, clinical claims and backlinks are excluded.
